summary: CloudStorage: A secure cloud storage platform with Internet Identity authentication, file management (upload/download, folders, tags, search), file previews (TXT, images, videos, docs), version history, recycle bin, secure sharing, periodic polling for synchronization, and admin dashboard with user management, analytics, and security monitoring. Files stored in IC canister storage.
architectural_notes: Files stored in Internet Computer canister storage with chunking for size limits
Periodic polling for synchronization instead of WebSockets
Browser-native file preview for TXT, images, videos, and documents
Role-based access control: Admin, Manager, User
known_issues: IC canister storage has size limits - requires chunking strategy
Polling-based sync may have latency compared to real-time WebSockets

existing_features.title: Implement periodic polling mechanism in the frontend that automatically refreshes the file list every 3-5 seconds using React Query with refetchInterval
Implement file preview functionality for TXT files (plain text display), images (PNG, JPG, GIF, SVG), videos (MP4, WebM), and documents (PDF) using browser-native rendering capabilities
Add periodic polling to the admin dashboard activity feed that refreshes every 5-10 seconds to show recent file operations and user actions
Implement storage quota tracking and enforcement per user with visual indicators showing used vs. available storage
